summary: Keep installer progress visible, add Nex completion with explicit restart, and show failure reasons with a local log viewer. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Waiting content and explicit branded completion/restart change installer feedback and final operator action.

api.reason: Local GTK and Debian preseed changes preserve installer operations; no Controller/Core or client contracts change.

state.reason: Installer presentation and input handling only; the installed host gains no new durable setting and the Controller stores nothing.
